notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.5 Now Live
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
- Edited Japanese and Chinese Localization
- Fixed Tutorials Sounds being louder than other sound effects
- Fixed shield SFX volume from Ozugo
- Fixed rendering sort of Rakz corals and Foul Breath skill
- Fixed the relics bug causing bosses to keep attacking after being dead
- Edited Elite Wizards and Final boss health
- Edited elite monsters and bosses' behaviour, like reducing idle time
- Reduce the number of summons with the Pet Wand
- Reduce the projectile's damage of the pet wand's summons
- Increase creature's stats improvement per level

notes.title: Play Folly of the Wizards Now!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone, [/p][p]
[/p][p]We’re delighted to have reached the stage where we can put the game in your hands! [/p][p]
[/p][p]Folly of the Wizards is now part of the Steam Next Fest so it’s your chance to play the game and let us know what you think! [/p][p]
[/p][p]Please stop by the forums and discuss your experience with the demo, and we’d appreciate you leaving a steam review so we can get your feedback. [/p][p]
[/p][p]We hope you have the best time playing the demo![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Numskull Games Joins Forces with Folly of the Wizards!
notes.content:
Hey, Fellow Wizards! 

The past two years have been a whirlwind of spells, strange monsters, and powerful wizards. We've been hard at work to bring Folly of the Wizards to life, and while there's still more to do, today we have some MAJOR NEWS to share with you!
We're absolutely thrilled to announce that [b]Numskull Games[/b] will be publishing Folly of the Wizards! 🎉🧙
To celebrate, we’re unveiling the official reveal trailer—check it out!

[previewyoutube=zasZcfy3ZkI;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you love it! Don’t forget to follow us on X to stay up-to-date with all the latest news and updates.
Also, we'd really appreciate it if you could wishlist Folly of the Wizards to show support for the game!

Stay safe and spellbound,
[i]The Folly of the Wizards Team[/i]
